sentences.text: 2. Charge sheet is filed against the petitioner by Kodihalli Police Station in Crime No.18/2023, for the offence punishable under Section 376 of IPC, Section 4 and 6 of POCSO Act and Section 9 of Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006.

3. This Court while disposing of Criminal petition No.3024/2023 by an order dated 28.06.2023,
which was dismissed as withdrawn, reserved liberty to the petitioner NC: 2023:KHC:40616 to move the Sessions Court once the victim's evidence is completed.
It appears that after the said order was passed, the petitioner has not moved the learned Sessions Judge.
Further, the deposition of the victim is also not furnished.

Sd/-
